decks.notes: This deck is focused on using control elements to gain an advantage over the opponent. It utilizes counterspells, removal, and card draw to maintain a dominant board presence. The inclusion of protection spells like Reverent Mantra and Worship, as well as creatures with protection abilities like Mother of Runes and Silver Knight, allows the deck to protect itself against threats while slowly chipping away at the opponent's resources. Standstill and Memory Lapse help to control the tempo of the game, while the inclusion of efficient creatures like Exalted Angel and Meddling Mage provide ways to win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Hermit Druid and Reanimate creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Sutured Ghoul for a powerful combo finish. Various spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Stifle and Vision Charm provide additional utility. The deck aims to win in a burst of speed and power, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and land destruction. The deck utilizes powerful cards such as The Rack and Pox to chip away at the opponent's life total while managing their board state. With a mix of efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures, Mono Black Control aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent until victory is secured. The inclusion of cards like Nether Spirit and Ensnaring Bridge further solidify the deck's control over the game.

The deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It seeks to control the board with cards like Pyrostatic Pillar and Sulfuric Vortex while applying pressure with creatures like Ball Lightning and Mogg Fanatic. The deck aims to end the game quickly by maximizing damage output through direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, while using cards like Fireblast for burst damage. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless onslaught of damage and pressure.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Buried Alive and Shallow Grave, then resurrect them with cards like Corpse Dance and Phyrexian Dreadnought to create a powerful attacking force. The deck also uses disruptive cards like Unmask and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Stifle and Lim-Dûl's Vault for additional control. The deck aims to quickly assemble the Sutured Ghoul and Phyrexian Dreadnought combo to deal with lethal damage to the opponent.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Exalted Angel and Hypnotic Specter, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate, and generate card advantage with Phyrexian Arena. The mana base includes Caves of Koilos and Tainted Field to support the deck's color requirements, while also including Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This aggressive mono black deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. By combining cheap creatures like Carnophage and Dauthi Slayer with powerful spells like Dark Ritual and Cursed Scroll, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The inclusion of cards like Phyrexian Negator and Flesh Reaver offer additional threats to close out the game quickly, while utility lands like Wasteland and Mishra's Factory provide flexibility and disruption in the mana base.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and resources while putting pressure on them with discard spells, efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter, and disruptive permanents like The Rack and Bottomless Pit. Utilizing removal spells like Snuff Out and Diabolic Edict, along with tools like Cursed Scroll and Funeral Charm, the deck aims to control the game through attrition and card advantage. The deck also includes utility lands like Wasteland and Mishra's Factory to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Exalted Angel and Hypnotic Specter, while also disrupting their game plan with discard spells like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate to deal with threats on the opponent's side of the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Phyrexian Arena provides card advantage and the ability to draw into more threats or disruption. Wasteland is included to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building up mana with various Elf creatures and Gaea's Cradle to play powerful spells such as Biorhythm and Survival of the Fittest. Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote provide additional utility and flexibility, while Tangle Wire helps disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with fast mana production and powerful plays, utilizing the synergy between Elves and various support cards to create a strong and aggressive board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Frantic Search and Attunement, then utilizing Replenish to bring them back all at once. This allows for explosive combos with Opalescence turning enchantments into creatures and Parallax Wave/Tide providing control and removal. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful board presence and disrupt their strategies with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Stifle. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure the deck can function smoothly and efficiently.

The core principle of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By efficiently using cards like Grim Lavamancer, Mogg Fanatic, and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage quickly. River Boa and Wild Mongrel provide additional threats while protecting key creatures. The inclusion of cards like Cursed Scroll and Rancor adds versatility and additional damage potential. Overall, this deck focuses on efficiently pressuring the opponent and maintaining board control to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing fast and efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Fireblast provide additional reach to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Bauble and Cursed Scroll helps to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on using cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to combo off and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to control the game with counterspells like Counterspell and Foil, while also being able to cycle through the deck quickly with cards like Gush and Impulse. The inclusion of Flash of Insight and Chain of Vapor adds additional versatility and options for dealing with threats. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a powerful combo while also having the ability to disrupt the opponent's game plan effectively.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Devourer with Fling in order to deal massive damage to the opponent in one turn. It uses cards like Tinker to search for key combo pieces and support cards like Defense Grid to protect it from disruption. The deck also includes mana acceleration in the form of artifacts like Fellwar Stone and Mind Stone to help ramp into the combo faster. Overall, the strategy is to efficiently set up and execute the combo as quickly as possible to secure victory.

The deck revolves around using Tinker to search for powerful artifacts, such as Phyrexian Devourer, and then quickly sacrificing them to deal massive damage with Fling. Defense Grid helps protect your combo pieces, while Tangle Wire slows down your opponent. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Mind Stone and Ancient Tomb. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly and overwhelm your opponent with a huge burst of damage before they can respond.
